notes: v1.14.561 — THE RACK COMES BACK ABOVE THE FOLD. ⛔ THIS FIXES A REGRESSION .558 INTRODUCED, and it was found by the sweep rather than by review. ops_ensureContainer inserted the OPS banner as bwShell.firstChild, where it measured 69px and pushed #bw-mount from top 647 to 731 against a nav top of 722. MEASURED WITH THE SAME PROBE AT BOTH VERSIONS: at .556 the rack sat above the nav with 75px visible; at .560 it sat entirely behind the bottom nav with ZERO visible. A technician in Field Mode had to scroll to see the rack the shift is about — undoing R1-D, shipped deliberately at .442. ⚠ MY OWN EARLIER TRIAGE MISSED THIS AND THE METHOD IS THE LESSON: the baseline compared PASS/FAIL STATUS, and 30-rack-above-the-fold failed at both .556 and .560, so it read as pre-existing. It was not — at .556 it failed on 'visible >= 150' with 75px, at .560 on the EARLIER assertion 'mountTop < navTop'. A TEST THAT FAILS AT BOTH VERSIONS CAN STILL HIDE A REGRESSION; comparing outcomes is not comparing behaviour. ⭐ TWO OWNER RULINGS COLLIDED and both still stand: SHIP-OPS-IN-PLACE (Build's tool door IS the OPS row) and R1-D (the rack comes above the fold). Ordering satisfies both — the banner now sits BELOW the rack preview, so the door keeps its home on Build one scroll-free tap under the thing the shift is about. ⚠ The insertion anchors on #bw-mount's own top-level ancestor rather than on the .bw-card.bw-prev class, which is bw_render's private markup and would break silently the next time that card is reshaped; with no rack present it warns and falls back to the old position, since there is then no rack to push. ALSO IN THIS SHIP, tests only: 29-context-follows-surface's two failures were STALE, not defects — they encoded the pre-.531 design where the rack detail held a WebGL mount. .531 deleted #reh3dMount by owner-approved ship, so 'absent' is now correct; :72 now asserts the flat elevation draws (measuring #rackCanvas, never the display:contents wrapper) and that Build let go, and :128 drives bw_mount3D directly because no natural path reaches the deferral guard any more. Both had been red since 2026-08-29, unnoticed, for want of a full sweep.
